verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas exposes a scriptable Editor API (api.playcanvas.com/editor) explicitly for building custom editing tools and integrating external data, and an official MCP server that lets AI assistants modify project data programmatically — both imply automation potential across many assets, but neither doc explicitly describes bulk/batch operations (e.g., multi-entity edits, batch asset import) or gives a hands-on example of many-item automation. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-edit/batch API examples, documented multi-item scripting workflows, and independent confirmation of large-scale automation via the MCP server or Editor API.
